title: Retain an exact high-frequency return under arbitrarily strong cyclic pulses
statement: Start from complex mode e3 exp(2pi i x1), or its real part. The first cyclic shear fixes it. For s2>=1024 choose second-direction error e1/(2pi s2), unit gain and zero phase, producing e3 exp(2pi i x1) exp(i cos(2pi x2)). The q=(1,1024,0) coefficient is J1024(1)e3, with J1024(1)>=[1-1/(4*1025)]/(2^1024*1024!)>0. Choose third-direction error -e2/1024, which annihilates coupling at q. Since that shear preserves the first two Fourier coordinates, no other intermediate mode changes this selected output. The coefficient remains exactly J1024(1) for every s1,s3 and every s2>=1024 under these admissible calibrations. Thus increasing strengths of this particular inviscid word cannot extend its arbitrary-accuracy block estimate past this return channel. This is not a full fixed-family, heat-gap or all-controller impossibility and does not contradict Dots’ different full programme.
